independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. This round I wrote only QA tests and evidence: the R15 spec at docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-15/e2e/dg2-qa-r15.spec.ts (outside the candidate, because the candidate is frozen), the evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-15/, and this record and its narrative. The round-15 repair FE13 (29da00d, D-075, F-DG2-500) is frontend-ux-engineer's. Every result comes from my own runs in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, all removed at the end: two clones at the source commit ed80b234, and one negative-control clone at c44da6f, the parent of FE13. HEAD was 9236a9f6 at the start, the round-15 freeze and assignment commit. During my run it moved to 0cf0d05 and then to 3cbdda88, through the other reviewers' auto-committed round-15 runs and evidence. Of the 152 files changed in ed80b234..HEAD, none is among the 561 manifest entries. The candidate ID recomputes as sha256:3f01c610... with 561 files in the tree and at --ref ed80b234, and --diff reports a match with no added, removed or changed files, both at the start and at the end. I did not open the other reviewers' round-15 records or evidence. I formed this verdict from my own runs. Of the validate --reconcile output, I read only the tail with my own 'round 15 qa-verifier: missing' line.

checks_run.procedure: R15-01 against the real API and PostgreSQL, EN and AR, both locale settings. User A (dev.office) opens A's record in Synthetic Finance, first the list and then the detail. dev.lead cannot read that record, which I checked through the API first. A real second tab's Sign out button ends A's session. Tab 1 walks Back (page.goBack) to an in-document /login entry. That page's own GET /me notices the session end, and the document is never reloaded. A MutationObserver now records every moment A's record text is in the document. User B (dev.lead) signs in with the development form in the same tab. B's list and detail reads are held for 1.2 s, so a stale cache would render first. B then walks forward through A's history entries (A's my-work, A's list, A's detail, whose cached query is keyed by A's record id) and back again, then opens A's detail URL in-document through the router, then the list.
checks_run.command: dg2-qa-r15.spec.ts R15-01 (part of QA-R15-17)
checks_run.expected: B never sees A's record at any moment: an empty observer log, and A's detail URL shows not-found for B. Same document throughout, B's identity shown and A's not, axe clean, no 429 and no page error.
checks_run.actual: 4/4 passed: EN and AR, in both unset and cutf8. The observer log was empty. On A's detail URL, B sees the not-found state ('غير موجود' in AR) with B's name in the header. The 6-step history walk stayed in one document. GET /me from the sign-in page through B's walk stayed under the bound of 25. Screenshots: B on A's detail URL and B's list, both languages.

checks_run.procedure: R15-02, EN and AR, both locale settings. Tab 1 shows A's list, and an observer records any moment where B's display name and A's record text are in the document together. In a second tab of the same browser, A signs out and B signs in, both through the UI, so tab 1 sees no 401. After GET /me's 60 s staleTime has passed, tab 1 is refocused with a visibilitychange event. TanStack then refetches /me, which returns another identity. B's list reads are held for 1.2 s.
checks_run.command: dg2-qa-r15.spec.ts R15-02 (part of QA-R15-17)
checks_run.expected: B's identity is never shown together with A's record (empty observer log); B is shown after the refocus; same document; GET /me after the refocus at most 3
checks_run.actual: 4/4 passed, with an empty observer log, B shown and the same document throughout.

checks_run.procedure: R15-03, EN and AR, both locale settings. A opens A's list and detail. After the list's 15 s staleTime, A's session is ended outside the React tree with the same cookie, and A follows the in-app Transformations link. The test checks the landing, samples the URL for 3 s, counts GET /me, then goes Back twice through A's entries with an observer recording A's record text. The earlier R14-01/02/03 checks of a single landing (other-tab sign-out, upload refused with 401, three tabs under the product's default limits) were re-run as part of QA-R15-17 and QA-R15-16.
checks_run.command: dg2-qa-r15.spec.ts R15-03 (part of QA-R15-17)
checks_run.expected: One in-app landing on /login?error=session_expired with the localized message, the right dir/lang and the form. The URL stays on /login for 3 s, no shell or Sign out button, at most 3 GET /me after the trigger. Back never renders the shell or A's record, and GET /me after Back is at most 6.
checks_run.actual: 4/4 passed. The landing came in-app with no reload, in the same document. The URL was ['/login'] for 3 s, with no shell after either Back step and an empty observer log. axe was clean on the landing.

checks_run.procedure: R15-04, EN and AR, both locale settings. A shows A's list. A second sign-in of the same browser replaces the cookie, so this tab's language save gets a real 403 csrf. Then a 403 forbidden on A's detail read is substituted with page.route, as the test name says. R14-04a/b (403 forbidden on a read and on a create, and a real 403 csrf) were re-run in QA-R15-17.
checks_run.command: dg2-qa-r15.spec.ts R15-04 (part of QA-R15-17)
checks_run.expected: After each 403 the user stays signed in where they are, with no /login and at most 2 GET /me. The session cache is not cleared, so A's record is still rendered on the list and after Back from the refused detail.
checks_run.actual: 4/4 passed: signed in throughout, still on /transformations and then on the detail URL, A's record still rendered, GET /me bounded. The same probe also passed on the pre-FE13 source (QA-R15-19), so it is a regression guard and shows FE13 did not turn a 403 into a session end.

checks_run.procedure: Run my R15 spec on c44da6f, the parent of FE13 29da00d: the round-14 source plus records, without the repair. The clone was built and run on its own qa-stack (ports 25451/25452, cutf8). First as one serial run, then each of R15-02, R15-03 and R15-04 on its own, because serial mode skips the tests after a failure.

checks_run.environment: disposable clone $TMPDIR/nc-c44da6f @c44da6f (removed at the end); node v24.21.0; Chromium /opt/pw-browsers

checks_run.actual: The designed failures happened. Serial run, exit 1: R15-01 failed in EN and AR at the assertion 'A's record text has count 0' after B opened A's detail URL. getByText('Synthetic QA R15 R15-01 A-only EN ...') had count 1, so B saw A's record from the stale cache. The 6 later tests were skipped by serial mode. Per-test run: R15-02 exited 1 in EN and AR, because the observer recorded ['/transformations']: B's identity and A's record were in the document together. R15-03 exited 0 (2/2) and R15-04 exited 0 (2/2). Those two are regression guards: before FE13, RequireSession already cleared the cache on an in-app end, and a 403 never ended the session. On the candidate the same spec passes 8/8 in each setting.

checks_run.procedure: Develop the R15 spec on the candidate (qa-stack, cutf8, ports 25441/25442). All 6 dev runs are kept; dev runs 1-5 exit 1 because of defects in my test, not in the product.
checks_run.command: e2e/support/qa-stack.sh npx playwright test e2e/dg2-qa-r15.spec.ts [--project chromium-en --grep R15-01] --workers=1
checks_run.expected: the final spec passes on the candidate; every earlier failure is explained
checks_run.actual:
Each failed dev run had a cause in my test, which I fixed:
- Dev runs 1 and 2 (exit 1): R15-01's Back walk went to about:blank. A Link to the same URL replaces the history entry, and the sign-in replaces /login, so no /login entry was left. Fix: start at /login?returnTo=/about, so the wordmark pushes /login.
- Dev run 3 (exit 1): in EN no Sign out button was found, because B's own preferred language (AR) applies after B's sign-in, which is correct product behaviour. The AR project left the document, because my 5-step Back walk reached about:blank. Fix: check B by display name and then ensureLanguage. Walk forward through A's entries, which the sign-in's replace keeps, and then back.
- Dev runs 4 and 5 (exit 1): R15-02 waited 0 s and then 16 s before the refocus. GET /me has a 60 s staleTime (useMeQuery), so no /me refetch happened, and tab 1 kept A's identity with A's data only. Fix: wait 61 s.
- Dev run 6: 8/8 passed, exit 0.
